raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

With the Megatron engine, `entropy_from_logits_with_chunking=True` fails in backward whenever the entropy is part of the graph:

```
RuntimeError: one of the variables needed for gradient computation has been modified by an inplace operation: [torch.cuda.FloatTensor [1, 2048, 131072]], which is output 0 of AsStrided, is at version 4; expected version 2 instead.
```

`vocab_parallel_entropy_with_chunking` applies `_VocabParallelEntropy` to chunks that are views of one logits tensor. Its backward subtracts from the saved logits in place and adds back afterwards. All views share one version counter, so the first chunk's backward invalidates the logits the other chunks saved.

It only shows up when the update forward computes the entropy with chunking, e.g. `entropy_coeff != 0`, or `calculate_entropy=True` in bypass mode (no old-log-prob recompute, so the entropy comes from the update forward; `0 * entropy_loss` still backpropagates). Related: #1970.

Chunks now use an out-of-place backward, which costs one temporary of chunk size. The unchunked path keeps the in-place backward, so its memory use is unchanged.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=entropy+chunking+inplace and https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues?q=vocab_parallel_entropy+inplace+operation (only the closed #1970).
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

`tests/special_distributed/test_tensor_dict.py::test_vocab_parallel_entropy` now also backpropagates through the chunked entropy and compares it with the unchunked gradient.

`torchrun --nproc-per-node=4 tests/special_distributed/test_tensor_dict.py` on 4 GPUs (TP2):

- `main` with the new check: all ranks fail with the error above.
- this PR: `test_vocab_parallel_entropy passes`, `test_vocab_parallel_sum_pi_squared passes`.

Found in a Nemotron-H 30B-A3B run at 256K context (Megatron engine, bypass mode, `calculate_entropy=True`, chunked entropy), which crashed on the first update.

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/utils/megatron/tensor_parallel.py`: `_VocabParallelEntropy.forward` takes `inplace_backward` (default `True`); the chunked wrapper passes `False`. Backward returns `None` for the extra argument.
- `tests/special_distributed/test_tensor_dict.py`: chunked forward/backward check in the existing entropy test.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to write this change; I reviewed it.

@@ -65,7 +65,7 @@ def test_all_gather_data_proto():
 def test_vocab_parallel_entropy():
     from megatron.core import parallel_state as mpu
 
-    from verl.utils.megatron.tensor_parallel import vocab_parallel_entropy
+    from verl.utils.megatron.tensor_parallel import vocab_parallel_entropy, vocab_parallel_entropy_with_chunking
     from verl.utils.profiler import log_gpu_memory_usage
     from verl.utils.torch_functional import entropy_from_logits
 
@@ -118,6 +118,16 @@ def test_vocab_parallel_entropy():
         logits[:, tp_rank * vocab_size_per_tp : (tp_rank + 1) * vocab_size_per_tp], vocab_parallel_logits
     )
 
+    # chunked entropy backpropagates through every chunk and matches the unchunked gradient
+    unchunked_grad = vocab_parallel_logits.grad.clone()
+    vocab_parallel_logits.grad = None
+    chunked_entropy = vocab_parallel_entropy_with_chunking(
+        vocab_parallel_logits.view(batch_size, seqlen, -1), chunk_size=seqlen // 4
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(chunked_entropy.view(-1), target_entropy)
+    chunked_entropy.backward(grad_output.view(batch_size, seqlen))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(vocab_parallel_logits.grad, unchunked_grad)
+
     if mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank() == 0:
         print("test_vocab_parallel_entropy passes")

@@ -108,7 +108,7 @@ def get_tensor_parallel_partition_stride(param):
 
 class _VocabParallelEntropy(torch.autograd.Function):
     @staticmethod
-    def forward(ctx, vocab_parallel_logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    def forward(ctx, vocab_parallel_logits: torch.Tensor, inplace_backward: bool = True) -> torch.Tensor:
         @torch.compile(dynamic=True)
         def mul_reduce(a, b):
             return (a * b).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
@@ -124,19 +124,23 @@ def mul_reduce(a, b):
         dist.all_reduce(sum_softmax_times_logits, group=mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_group())
         entropy = logits_max + normalized_sum_exp_logits.log() - sum_softmax_times_logits
         ctx.save_for_backward(vocab_parallel_logits, softmax_logits, sum_softmax_times_logits)
+        ctx.inplace_backward = inplace_backward
         return entropy.squeeze(dim=-1)
 
     @staticmethod
     def backward(ctx, grad_output: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
         vocab_parallel_logits, softmax_logits, sum_softmax_times_logits = ctx.saved_tensors
         # reuse softmax_logits as grad
-        vocab_parallel_logits.sub_(sum_softmax_times_logits)
-        softmax_logits.mul_(vocab_parallel_logits)
+        if ctx.inplace_backward:
+            vocab_parallel_logits.sub_(sum_softmax_times_logits)
+            softmax_logits.mul_(vocab_parallel_logits)
+            # recover vocab_parallel_logits
+            vocab_parallel_logits.add_(sum_softmax_times_logits)
+        else:
+            softmax_logits.mul_(vocab_parallel_logits - sum_softmax_times_logits)
         softmax_logits.mul_(grad_output.unsqueeze(dim=-1))
-        # recover vocab_parallel_logits
-        vocab_parallel_logits.add_(sum_softmax_times_logits)
         softmax_logits.mul_(-1)
-        return softmax_logits
+        return softmax_logits, None
 
 
 def vocab_parallel_entropy(vocab_parallel_logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
@@ -164,7 +168,8 @@ def vocab_parallel_entropy_with_chunking(vocab_parallel_logits: torch.Tensor, ch
 
     for i in range(0, vocab_parallel_logits.shape[1], chunk_size):
         logits_chunk = vocab_parallel_logits[:, i : i + chunk_size, :]
-        entropy_chunk = _VocabParallelEntropy.apply(logits_chunk)
+        # Chunks are views of one tensor: an in-place backward on one invalidates the others.
+        entropy_chunk = _VocabParallelEntropy.apply(logits_chunk, False)
         entropy[:, i : i + chunk_size] = entropy_chunk
 
     return entropy
